name: pixelforge
description: Node-based LED sequencer with sACN output, 3D visualisation, and live effect authoring
author: PixelForge

scripts.test: npx tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.node.json --test src/main/player/startup.test.ts src/main/engine/engineRestart.test.ts src/engine-host/aled.test.ts src/engine-host/bake.test.ts src/engine-host/evaluator.test.ts src/engine-host/fseq.test.ts src/engine-host/generatorScope.test.ts src/engine-host/gpuTops.test.ts src/engine-host/loopPeriod.test.ts src/engine-host/pixelScope.test.ts src/engine-host/ports.test.ts src/engine-host/shaders.test.ts src/engine-host/share.test.ts src/engine-host/timeline.test.ts

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PixelForge analyzes audio input for reactive LED visuals.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: PixelForge sends LED pixel data to fixtures on your local network via sACN, Art-Net, or DDP.
